messages.subject: Import Problem "Couldn't find installable ISAM. (Error number:
parts:
Dear Listers,

=20

While I'm confident I can't be the first person to submit this problem I
cannot find reference to it through the search engine. Only way back
from version 3.5.

=20

When trying to import some simple data into Distance I get this message.

=20

Problem reading data file

=20

An problem occurred while Distance was trying to read the file

=20

C:\Documents and Settings\hemsong\Desktop\Example1.txt

=20

This may be because the wrong delimiter is selected - check the
delimiter is correct. Problems also occur if the file is open in another
application. If you cannot find the source of the problem, exit the
wizard and check the file using a Windows editor.

=20

The error message generated by the database was : "Couldn't find
installable ISAM. (Error number: 3170)"

=20

Worse yet I get the same message when I try to import the example data
(in fact I have slavishly typed the error message from that attempt
above) set referenced in the help files. Is there a workaround for this?
I am running Distance 6.2 on Windows XP.

=20

Best,

=20
